{{Current events|year=2019|month=08|day=12|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*[[2019 Argentine general election]]
**After [[President of Argentina|Argentine President]] [[Mauricio Macri]] comes second in [[Argentina]]'s [[Primary elections in Argentina|primary elections]], the country's [[Argentine peso|peso]] loses 15% of its value against the [[United States dollar|US dollar]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-argentina-election/macri-vows-to-win-second-term-after-argentine-peso-crashes-on-primary-results-idUSKCN1V209J (Reuters)]

;International relations 
*[[Japan–South Korea relations]]
**In a [[tit for tat|tit-for-tat]] move, [[South Korea]] removes [[Japan]] from its preferred trade list. [https://www.usnews.com/news/business/articles/2019-08-12/south-korea-to-remove-japan-from-preferred-trade-list (US News)]
*[[Human rights in Venezuela]]
**Venezuelan activist [[Tamara Sujú]] visits [[London]] to ask the [[United Kingdom]], and specifically [[Dominic Raab]], to pressure the [[International Criminal Court]] to investigate claims of torture and human rights abuses by the [[Nicolás Maduro]] government. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/aug/12/venezuela-activist-calls-on-uk-to-back-icc-referral-over-human-rights-maduro (''The Guardian'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Death of Jeffrey Epstein]]
**[[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] agents [[police raid|raid]] late financier billionaire [[Jeffrey Epstein]]'s [[Little Saint James, U.S. Virgin Islands|private Caribbean island]], amid an investigation into alleged [[sex trafficking]]. The raid comes two days after Epstein's death.  [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/fbi-agents-swarm-jeffrey-epstein-s-private-caribbean-island-n1041596 (NBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protests|Hong Kong protests]]
**The [[Airport Authority Hong Kong]] cancels all departure flights from [[Hong Kong]], effectively locking down [[Hong Kong International Airport]] amid ongoing unrest. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-49317975 (BBC)]
**A spokesperson for [[China]]'s [[Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office]] releases a statement accusing violent protesters that threw [[petrol bomb]]s at [[Hong Kong Police]] officers of being "[[terrorism in China|terrorists]]", saying that a violent minority within the pro-democracy movement poses "a serious challenge to Hong Kong's prosperity and stability". [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/hong-kong-protest-china-slams-violence-terrorism-11802762 (''Channel News Asia'')]
*[[2019 Argentine general election]]
**Former [[Chief of the Cabinet of Ministers]] [[Alberto Fernández]] gains a 15% lead over incumbent [[President of Argentina|President]] [[Mauricio Macri]] in [[Argentina]]'s [[Primary elections in Argentina|primaries]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/08/12/world/americas/argentina-election-macri-kirchner.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Operation Car Wash]]
**Text messages leaked by ''[[The Intercept Brasil]]'' show that [[Deltan Dallagnol]], former coordinator of Operation Car Wash's prosecution team and anti-corruption public figure, knew that [[President of Brazil|Brazilian President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]]'s [[Chief of Staff of Brazil|Chief of Staff]] [[Onyx Lorenzoni]] was involved in corruption, but chose not to act on it. [https://odia.ig.com.br/brasil/2019/08/5671818-vaza-jato--dallagnol-sabia-que-onyx-estava-envolvido-com-corrupcao--mas-nao-fez-nada.html (''O Dia'')]
